spans.s:
द्वैगत द्वैगत, अम्, n. (fr. द्वि-गत्), Ved.,
N. of a Sāman.

द्वैगुणिक द्वैगुणिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. द्वि-
गुण), one who requires the double or cent per cent
interest; (अस्), m. an usurer, money-lender.

द्वैगुण्य, अम्, n. the double, double amount,
double value or measure, double the amount; duality;
doubling; the possession of two out of the three
qualities.

द्वैजात द्वैजात, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. द्वि-जाति), be-
longing to the twice-born, consisting of twice-born
men, belonging to one of the three higher classes.

द्वैत द्वैत, अम्, n. (fr. 1. द्वि-ता), duality,
the state of being doubled, duplicity, dualism in philo-
sophy, the assertion of two principles (as of spirit
and matter, God and the universe, &c.); doubt.
—द्वैत-निर्णय, अस्, m. ‘the decision or discus-
sion of duality,’ N. of a philosophical work by Vācas-
pati-miśra.
—द्वैत-परिशिष्ट, अम्, n. ‘the re-
mainder of discussions on duality,’ N. of a work by
Keśava.
—द्वैत-भृत, आस्, m. pl., N. of a philo-
sophical school.
—द्वैत-वादिन्, ई, m. ‘an assertor
of dualism,’ a philosopher who asserts the two prin-
ciples or the existence of the soul as separate from
the Supreme Being.
—द्वैत-विवेक, अस्, m. ‘dis-
crimination of duality,’ N. of a part of the Pañca-
daśī by Bhāratī-tīrtha.
—द्वैत-वैतथ्योपनिषद्
(˚य-उप्˚), त्, f., N. of an Upaniṣad.

द्वैतवन, अस्, m. (fr. द्वित-वन), Ved. a
[]
patronymic of the king Dhvasan; (अस्, ई, अम्), be-
longing or relating to Dhvasan Dvaitavana.

द्वैतीयक, अस्, ई, अम्, returning every second
day, second; [cf. द्वितीयक.]

द्वैध द्वैध, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. द्वि-धा), two-
fold, double; (अम्), n. duality, duplicity, double exist-
ence or nature, twofold form or state, a double re-
source, secondary array or reserve; division or sepa-
ration into two parts; disunion, diversity, difference,
variance, contest, conflict, a duel; doubt, uncertainty;
a dilemma; contradiction, dispute; (अम्), ind. in
two parts, into two portions; in two ways, doubly.
—द्वैधा-करण, अम्, n. making into two, sepa-
rating into two parts, disuniting.
—द्वैधी-कृत,
अस्, आ, अम्, separated, made twofold, divided into
two, sundered; brought into a dilemma.
—द्वैधी-
भाव, अस्, m. twofold form or state, a double state,
duality, duplicity, double nature, the nature or pro-
perty of being two or distinct; separation into two,
difference; contest, dispute, doubt, dilemma, uncer-
tainty; sowing dissension or causing the separation
of allies, dividing an army into two detachments,
making peace with one and waging war with another
(one of the six kinds of military tactics); falsehood.
—द्वैधी-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -भवितुम्, to
become separated or divided into two parts, to be
disunited.
—द्वैधी-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, separated
into two, divided, disunited.

द्वैध्य, अम्, n. ‘the state of being twofold,’
double nature, duplicity; diversity, variance, discre-
pancy; falsehood.

द्वैप द्वैप, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. द्वीप), being or
living on an island, an islander; occurring on an
island; (fr. द्वीपिन्), belonging to a tiger or panther,
made of a tiger's skin, covered with it; (अस्), m. a
car covered or hung with a tiger's skin.

द्वैपक, अस्, ई, अम्, living on an island, an
islander.

द्वैपायन, अस्, m. (fr. द्वीप), ‘the island-
born,’ N. of Vyāsa, author or compiler of the Vedas
and Purāṇas, (the place of his nativity being a small
island in the Ganges); (अस्, ई, अम्), relating to
Dvaipāyana.

द्वैप्य, अस्, आ or -पी, अम् (fr. द्वीप), of or
relating to an island or peninsula, the inhabitant of
an island or of the coast, an islander.

द्वैपक्ष द्वैपक्ष, अम्, n. (fr. द्वि-पक्ष),
two factions or parties.

द्वैपद द्वैपद, अस्, m. (fr. द्वि-पद), a
combination or compound of two words.
—द्वै-
पद-शस्, ind. in a compound or combination of
two words.

द्वैपदिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. द्वि-पदा), familiar
with the Dvi-padā.

द्वैपराक द्वैपराक, अस्, m. (fr. द्वि-पराक),
N. of a Tri-rātra.

द्वैपारायणिक द्वैपारायणिक, अस्, ई, अम्, one
who performs the Pārāyaṇa twice.

द्वैभाव्य द्वैभाव्य, अम्, n. double nature,
division or separation into two.

द्वैमातुर द्वैमातुर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. द्वि-
मातृ), having two mothers, i. e. a natural mother
and a step-mother; having another mother, having
two different mothers (as two brothers); (अस्), m.
an epithet of Gaṇeśa [cf. द्विमातृ-ज]; of Jarā-
sandha.

द्वैमातृक, अस्, ई, अम्, nourished by rain and
rivers (as a country; cf. देवमातृक and नदी-
मतृक).

द्वैमित्रि द्वैमित्रि, इस्, इस्, इ (fr. द्वि-मित्र),
born of two friends.

द्वैयह्निक द्वैयह्निक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. द्वि-
अहन्), of or belonging to two days.

द्वैयोग्य द्वैयोग्य, अम्, n. (fr. द्वि-योग),
a combination of two.

द्वैरथ द्वैरथ, अम्, n. (fr. द्वि-रथ),
‘chariot-duel,’ a single combat in chariots, single
combat in general; (अस्, ई, अम्), relating to a single
combat in chariots; (अस्), m. an adversary.

द्वैराज्य द्वैराज्य, अम्, n. (fr. द्वि-राजन्), a
dominion divided between two princes.

द्वैरात्रिक द्वैरात्रिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. द्वि-
रात्र), of or belonging to a period of two nights.

द्वैवर्षिक द्वैवर्षिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. द्वि-
वर्ष), biennial, happening after two years.

द्वैविध्य द्वैविध्य, अम्, n. (fr. द्वि-विध),
the state of being twofold, duality, twofold manner
or character, duplicity, diversity, variance.

द्वैशाण द्वैशाण, अस्, ई, अम्, worth two
Śāṇas; [cf. द्वि-शाण and द्विशाण्य.]

द्वैषणीया द्वैषणीया, f. (fr. द्वेषणीय), a
sort of betel pepper.

द्वैसमिक द्वैसमिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. द्वि-समा),
two years old.

द्वैहायन द्वैहायन, अम्, n. (fr. द्वि-हा-
यन), the age of two years, the state of being two
years old.

द्वैरूप्य, अम्, n. (fr. द्वि-रूप), duality of
form, double appearance.
